title: The Beginning of the Creative Writing Club
description: The Creative Writing Club held its first official meeting, bringing together its founding team members.

title: Website Development Begins
description: As discussions began about expanding the club across the school, the vice president decided to develop a dedicated website. Over time, the website would undergo numerous layout changes and redesigns to achieve a more professional appearance.

title: The First Website Preview
description: After just over a week of continuous development, an early version of the website was unveiled to club members, offering a first look at its temporary design and layout.

title: A New Identity and Website Redesign
description: As the club continued to develop, members discussed establishing an official name, eventually settling on 'Novice Ink.' The same month also marked a complete website redesign, introducing a new layout and improved mobile compatibility.

title: The Official Website Launch
description: The club prepared to release its website to the public, allowing aspiring writers to submit their stories for review and potentially become club members. A promotional poster was also distributed to announce the launch.

title: The Debut of Novice Ink.'s First Magazine
description: Novice Ink. officially published its first magazine issue for the 2020–2021 school year. Although the magazine was completed on May 21, 2021, it became available on the website the following day. Special recognition goes to club president Victoria Nasibi for her outstanding work in bringing the publication to completion.

title: Closing the Club's First School Year
description: With the school year ending in approximately one week, Novice Ink. held its final meeting for the 2020-2021 academic year. Although club meetings were scheduled to resume in September, website updates and development would continue throughout the summer.

title: Novice Ink. Secures Its Official Domain
description: After months of development and securing a sufficient budget to maintain the website, club programmer and vice president Hairum purchased a dedicated domain to replace the previously used subdomain. Following several purchases, https://noviceinkwritersclub.com/ became the club's official website address.

title: Celebrating One Year of Novice Ink.
description: Although the club's exact founding date remained a subject of debate, members agreed to recognize October 21, 2020, as its official starting point. One year later, Novice Ink. celebrated its first anniversary, reflecting on its progress and looking forward to continued growth in the years ahead.

title: Preparing the Second Magazine Issue
description: The club president and vice president worked together to prepare the second issue of Novice Ink.'s magazine for printing. Known as the 'Winter Edition,' this issue centered on the theme of self-development. The day also marked the printing of the magazine's first prototype.

title: Volume II Officially Goes to Print
description: Novice Ink.'s president and vice president completed the preparation, printing, and distribution of orders for the club's second magazine issue. The first official copy was assembled, with distribution primarily focused on teachers and staff who had purchased a copy. Their generous support played an essential role in making the publication possible.

title: Final Preparations for the Year-End Celebration
description: As the 2021-2022 school year approached its conclusion, the club president and vice president finalized preparations for the end-of-year celebration scheduled for June 2, 2022. Their efforts included completing the remaining magazine copies for club members and themselves, along with preparing gifts to recognize members' participation and contributions over the years.

title: Novice Ink.'s Final Club Meeting
description: With the 2021-2022 school year nearing its end, Novice Ink. held its final club meeting ahead of the year-end ceremony. The occasion provided an opportunity to reflect on the club's remarkable growth and express hope for its continued success after the president, vice president, and several other members graduated the following month.

title: An Updated Website Preview Goes Live
description: Following more than six months of continued development, Novice Ink.'s website developer released a preview of the site's latest improvements. Although development was still ongoing, the updated website became accessible through a new temporary subdomain, allowing visitors to explore its redesigned features and changes.

title: A Farewell Celebration for Novice Ink.
description: Novice Ink. gathered for its final celebration of the school year, organized by club administrator Ms. O'Donnell, president Victoria Nasibi, and vice president Hairum Qureshi. The ceremony brought members together to celebrate the year's accomplishments, distribute awards and gifts, reflect on the club's progress, and bid farewell to graduating members of the Class of 2022. The event also served as an expression of gratitude to everyone who supported the club throughout its journey.

title: Farewell to the Class of 2022
description: Graduation day marked the transition of Christiana High School's senior class into graduates and alumni. Among them were Novice Ink. members Hairum Qureshi, Rayyan Khan, and Victoria Nasibi, whose graduation also marked their official departure from the club and the conclusion of their time as student members.

title: Revisiting the Past: A Website Reimagined
description: More than four years after graduating, Novice Ink.'s former vice president and website developer, Hairum Qureshi, revisited one of his earliest web development projects. Drawing on years of experience, he independently rebuilt the website to realize his original vision and reflect his growth as a software engineer and computer science graduate. While the project gives the website new life, it does not represent a revival of Novice Ink. or renewed affiliation with the club. Instead, it serves as a personal tribute to the club's history, legacy, and memories.
